sections.voiceover: Most NFL final scores have happened before, but the Bengals just made history.

However, this 38-18 result is the 1,100th unique final score in 107 years.
This game followed the Cowboys and 49ers matchup that hit 1,099 earlier that day. Joe Burrow’s performance helped secure this Scorigami, a rare score never seen in NFL history.
The 1,100th unique final score changed the league history books.
